description: Source code for handling image tags in firmware, including CRC calculations, image validation, and fixup routines for embedded device firmware images.

classes.name: bcm_tag
classes.description: Structure representing the firmware image tag with metadata and CRCs.

methods.name: strntoul
methods.description: Converts a string segment to an unsigned 32-bit integer with specified length and base.

methods.name: compute_crc32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum over a specified file region.

methods.name: trx_fixup
methods.description: Fixes the image tag header CRC and resets root length to zero.

methods.name: trx_check
methods.description: Validates the image header CRC and checks if the image fits in the specified MTD partition.

methods.name: mtd_fixtrx
methods.description: Fixes the TRX header in a specified MTD device offset.
